contract.languagePolicy: Primary teaching narration is Vietnamese and preserves project mathematical language.
contract.voiceRole: Vietnamese teaching voice, male Southern Vietnamese style; provider voice IDs are adapter metadata.
contract.mathReadingPolicy: Derive speech from canonical notation, including explicit identifiers Ox, Oy, Oz, and Oxyz.
contract.symbolReadingPolicy: Verbalize canonical symbols pedagogically without redefining their mathematical meaning.
contract.geometryReadingPolicy: Derive narration from semantic geometry and never add unstated relations.
contract.pacePolicy: Use semantic pace and pause levels; adapters translate them to provider timing.
contract.sceneNarrationBinding: Bind narration to the canonical progressive solution sequence and preserve QUESTION_TOP / SOLUTION_LEFT / GEOMETRY_RIGHT.
contract.captionTranscriptBinding: Caption and transcript derive from shared canonical narration content and provenance.
contract.ttsAdapterPolicy: TTS_PROVIDER != VOICE_AUTHORITY; every provider is an ADAPTER_BOUNDARY behind the MST-MATH Voice Resolver.
